the migration structure of the Russian intellectual elite is changing, and the number of people leaving Russia is increasing.

the migration structure of Russian researchers is characterized by the following features: a) a significant proportion of researchers and university professors emigrate to the more economically advanced countries; b) the proportion of those who emigrate for business and commerce reasons is also high; c) the majority of those who relocate to different Russian regions do so for family reasons, and the proportion of researchers who emigrate to other countries of the former USSR is relatively low; d) there is an increasing attractiveness of emigration to study abroad
the Russian science is facing a number of problems.

the study of the migration of Russian intellectuals in the context of the academic and business environment in Russia and in the world.
the problems of migration of Russian scientists and researchers, which is causing significant damage to the economy and the development of Russian science.
the problems of migration, "brain drain," and "brain gain" in the context of the Russian academic and industry environment, which is a very important and topical issue in Russia.

the current migration structure of Russian scientists is a result of the lack of a state policy aimed at improving the working and living conditions for Russian scientists, as well as a result of the absence of a state policy on the development of science and education, and a result of the low social prestige of science in Russian society.
the current situation is not sustainable and requires a radical solution.

the main problem is the lack of a clear and long-term strategy in the field of science and education in Russia, which would ensure its sustainable development.

the main causes of the migration of researchers from Russia are the lack of prospects for the development of science, low salaries, and the lack of social prestige of the academic profession.

the migration of scientists and researchers is a serious problem for the Russian economy.
the migration structure of Russian intellectuals within the academic and industry environments, and the reasons for this, is a complex process that cannot be fully explained by a single cause.
the migration structure of Russian scientists and university professors is determined not only by the economic and social conditions of their work, but also by their personal characteristics.
